entry.title: Version 4.3.71
entry.content:
Released Feb 15, 2026 - 351.09 KB — RYS Premium — Optional paid tier

And improvements:
  • "Hide all Shorts" is now enabled by default
  • "Hide all but the first row" now works with YouTube's latest homepage layout
  • Sidebar ad panels are now hidden by default
  • Dark mode fixes and UI polish throughout

entry.title: Version 4.3.70
entry.content:
Released Feb 9, 2026 - 340.99 KB — New
- Hide YouTube Playables shelf on the homepage (#158, #175)
- Always theater mode option (#195)
- Hide search result descriptions (#197)
- Hide bell notification count from page title (#199)
- Extension no longer runs on YouTube Music (#152)

Fixed
- "Hide extra rows" now works with YouTube's updated homepage layout
- Shrink thumbnails now works on the homepage
- Fixed thumbnail shrinking/overlapping on channel page tabs (#196)

Other
- Deprecated "disable playlist autoplay" setting
- Options page auto-selects Homepage section when on YouTube homepage
